factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.

factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.

factory: My Father Cigars S.A.

factory: Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A. (TABSA, Aganorsa)

factory: My Father Cigars S.A.

factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.

factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.

about: Foundation's Jamaican-themed infused line, built around Jamaican Cow Tongue filler tobacco blended with Nicaraguan leaf. It is named after Lee "Scratch" Perry's band and each size has its own wrapper.

Wrapper depends on the size: Zola and Original Rude Boy are Broadleaf, Django is Sumatra, Para El Sapo is Candela, the rest Connecticut Shade. The Skipper and Para El Sapo are figurados tapering from 38 to 54 ring. Factory is not disclosed.
